sn12.12:1.3: The Exalted One was teaching the doctrine of the four sustenances.
sn12.12:2.1: And when he had named them the venerable Moliya-Phagguna said to the Exalted One:
sn12.12:2.2: “Who now is it, lord, who feeds on the consciousness sustenance?”
sn12.12:2.3: “Not a fit question.” said the Exalted One.
sn12.12:2.5: If I were saying so, to that the question would be a fit one.
sn12.12:2.7: But I am not saying so. If you were to ask me:
sn12.12:2.9: ‘of what now, lord, is consciousness the sustenance ?’
sn12.12:2.10: this were a fit question. And the fit answer to it is:
sn12.12:2.11: ‘the consciousness-sustenance is the cause of renewed becoming, of rebirth in the future. When that is come to pass, is present, the sixfold sense-sphere becomes, and conditioned by the sixfold sense-sphere contact becomes.’”
sn12.12:3.2: “Not a fit question,” said the Exalted One.
sn12.12:3.4: If I were saying so, the question would be a fit one.
sn12.12:3.6: But I am not saying so.
sn12.12:3.7: And I not saying so, if you were to ask thus:
sn12.12:3.8: ‘Conditioned now by what, lord, is contact?’
sn12.12:3.9: this is a fit question. And the fit answer there would be:
sn12.12:3.10: ‘conditioned by the sixfold sense-sphere is contact; conditioned by contact is feeling.’”
sn12.12:4.1: “Who now, lord, is it who feels?”
sn12.12:4.2: “Not a fit question,” said the Exalted One.
sn12.12:4.4: If I were saying so, the question would be a fit one. But I am not saying so.
sn12.12:4.6: And I am not saying so,
sn12.12:4.7: if you were to ask thus:
sn12.12:4.8: ‘Conditioned now by what, lord, is feeling?’
sn12.12:4.9: this were a fit question. And the fit answer there would be:
sn12.12:4.10: ‘Conditioned by contact is feeling, conditioned by feeling is craving.’”
sn12.12:5.1: “Who now, lord, is it who craves?”
sn12.12:5.2: “Not a fit question,” said the Exalted One.
sn12.12:5.4: If I were saying so, the question would be a fit one.
sn12.12:5.6: But I am not saying so.
sn12.12:5.7: And I not saying so, if you were to ask thus:
sn12.12:5.8: ‘Conditioned now by what, lord, is craving ?’
sn12.12:5.9: this were a fit question. And the fit answer there would be:
sn12.12:5.10: ‘Conditioned by feeling is craving. Conditioned by craving is grasping.’”
sn12.12:6.1: “Who now, lord, is it who grasps ?”
sn12.12:6.2: “Not a fit question,” said the Exalted One
sn12.12:6.4: If I were saying so, the question would be a fit one.
sn12.12:6.6: But I am not saying so.
sn12.12:6.7: And I not saying so, if you were to ask thus:
sn12.12:6.8: ‘Conditioned now by what, lord, is there grasping?’
sn12.12:6.9: this were a fit question. And the fit answer there would be:
sn12.12:6.11: ‘Conditioned by grasping is becoming.’” And so on.
sn12.12:6.12: “Such is the uprising of this entire mass of Ill.
sn12.12:7.1: But from the utter fading away and cessation of the sixfold sphere of sense-contact, Phagguna, comes cessation of contact,
sn12.12:7.2: from cessation of contact, cessation of feeling,
sn12.12:7.3: from cessation of feeling, cessation of craving,
sn12.12:7.7: ... of decay-and-death, of grief lamentation, suffering, unhappiness, despair.
sn12.12:7.8: Such is the cessation of this entire mass of ill.”
